description.en: Original stylized Chondrites ichnogenus trace-morphology concept. The original Carboniferous Waverly source is tentatively identified; its uncertainty is retained. Clearer published Chondrites photographs and genus diagnosis supplement branching morphology only, not the date or identification of the Waverly specimen. No animal identity, feeding mechanism or environmental indicator claimed. Relief polarity, composition and20cm slab size are illustrative.
